description: A meeting memo with numbered paragraphs but no questions: the API must answer 422 NO_ITEMS instead of inventing items from the numbered list.
titulo: Minutes of the October team meeting
instructions: 1. The team reviewed the progress of the reading project and agreed to keep the current schedule.
2. The budget for printed materials stays within the approved amount.
3. The next meeting will take place on the first Monday of November at 10:00.
4. Every coordinator will send a short summary of their area one week before the meeting.
